heading: Tonight
text: Periods of clouds, with showers arriving in the Hudson Valley near midnight, becoming likely from the Champlain Valley east overnight. Milder. Lows in the 50s to near 60. Winds south up to 10 mph east, and 10 to 15, gusting 20 to 30 mph from the Green Mountains west.

heading: Sunday
text: Morning showers through NH, and from St. Johnsbury, Rutland, and Lake George south ending. Periods of clouds, limited sun, with scattered afternoon showers or a thunderstorm in the Adirondacks, spreading east to the northern Green Mountains late. Highs in the 70s. Winds south, shifting to the southwest near 10 mph east, and 10 to 15 mph from the Green Mountains west.

heading: Sunday Night
text: Scattered showers or a thunderstorm, reaching southeast VT and southern NH after midnight, and tapering off northwest, giving way to partial clearing. Lows in the 50s. Winds west near 10 mph, becoming light and variable in wind-sheltered valleys.

heading: Monday
text: Partly sunny, with a few localized, passing morning showers north, and becoming mostly sunny south. Breezy and cool. Highs in the 60s north, to near 70 south. Winds becoming northwest 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph from the Green Mountains east.
